# REFERENCE STACK — MV-23 (autogenerated per project, built 2026-11-20 before volley 1)

All refs generated in-project (media.generate_image), cropped to 16:9 (1920x1080), warm photoreal, zero text. Character refs READ BACK and verified by eye before use: Ranch — slicked dark hair with a wave, thin pencil moustache, cream fringed western suit, turquoise bolo tie, tan cowboy boots, cream Stetson in hand (matches lock); Tilly — auburn victory-roll hair, teal blouse, yellow measuring tape, pincushion (matches lock; tape numerals are prop texture, vehicles avoid tape close-ups). Shop ref carries the red runner, three-panel mirror wall, hat wall, boot shelves, fitting platform and mezzanine staircase the plan stages on. Boardwalk ref carries the swing doors and shop front for S11.

Chaining: within a section, take N+1 conditions on take N's last frame (extracted to work/stills/chain/) as second image where the plan holds framing; fresh starts use the scene's own ref. Never chain from a rejected take.
Per-scene refs are named in work/scenes.json; each vehicle file carries the full prompt text.
